plugins.description: The Aqmen connector plus thin skills for Claude: market sizing, company analysis, competitive landscape, due diligence, proposal and refresh, chaining scope, research, model, challenge, conclude and deliver — the method read from the platform, with parallel researchers and fresh-context critics on top. Each job is a project in the client's workspace; deliverables are decks and docs with every figure sourced, exportable to PowerPoint and Word.
